name: monster-island
description: Monster Island - a 3D monster-befriending adventure where English is how you make friends (Japanese grade 3-6).

scripts.e2e: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs -- "npm run build && playwright test --project=functional"
scripts.e2e:visual: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs -- "npm run build && playwright test --project=visual --pass-with-no-tests"
scripts.e2e:perf: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs -- "npm run build && playwright test --project=perf --pass-with-no-tests"
scripts.e2e:full: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs -- "npm run build && playwright test --pass-with-no-tests"
scripts.e2e:compat: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs --swiftshader -- "npm run build && playwright test --project=functional"
scripts.shots: node tests/support/test-lock.mjs -- "npm run build && node scripts/shots.mjs"
